agnostic_oa_w2090467627_charges_as_cycle.nonparaphrase_operation: Start from a relation matrix defining a quotient action, realize its columns as exponents in tensor products of associated line bundles, apply an additive invariant such as the first Chern class, and then use duality to translate the relation into cycles. agnostic_oa_w2090467627_charges_as_cycle.source_support: The excerpt treats the quotient as D-3 circle fibrations with associated line bundles M_I and states that their Poincare-dual Chern classes C_I form a basis of H_3(Y;Z) under its assumptions. It gives L_A as the tensor product over I of M_I raised to Q_I^A and concludes [Sigma_A]=sum_I Q_I^A C_I; the source then identifies the baryonic charge B_I[X_A] with Q_I^A.

agnostic_oa_w2090467627_compact_tiling_e.source_support: The excerpt states that faces represent gauge groups, edges represent bifundamental fields, and vertices represent superpotential terms; with appropriate periodicity the vertices are bipartite. agnostic_oa_w2090467627_compare_extremiz.interpretation: Source fact: after a common three-variable parametrization, the field-theoretic stationarity equations reduce to the same system as the geometric calculation, and only one of three formal solutions has nonzero field charges and is a local maximum. agnostic_oa_w2090467627_compare_extremiz.nonparaphrase_operation: Map both descriptions into common variables, derive their stationarity systems without comparing objective names, and reduce the systems while recording divisions and eliminated branches. agnostic_oa_w2090467627_compare_extremiz.source_support: The excerpt parametrizes six R-charges by x,y,z so that the beta-function constraints vanish, writes the trial cubic central charge, and gives its three stationarity equations. agnostic_oa_w2090467627_compare_extremiz.uncertainty: The comparison target (3.36) is not reproduced inside this isolated artifact, so identity with it is a source assertion rather than independently checkable here.
